meta.name: modlens
meta.description: Plug-in vision for text-only models. Hard rule: when a file path or URL with an image extension (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, .gif, .heic, .heif) appears anywhere in the conversation (typed by the user, injected as a `[Image: source: <path>]` line, or inside a tag) and you cannot see that image's content, run this skill on it before any other approach: no self-built OCR, no PIL, no tesseract. Also triggers on pasted-image placeholders such as `[Image #1]` and `[Unsupported Image]`. If you can actually see the image, do not use this skill. When unsure, run `modlens guard` before the first read of a session: a deny verdict means the active model has native vision and must read the image itself. Runs the modlens CLI to convert the image into structured JSON evidence: every word transcribed, layout regions, semantics, visual clues. Also use when the user asks how to install, configure, or switch modlens providers (Gemini API key, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Claude API or Claude Code CLI).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把图片内容转成结构化文字，让纯文本模型也能看懂图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的只能处理文字的AI助手希望看懂图片内容
copy.tagline_en: Turn images into structured text so text-only models can read them
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your text-only AI needs to understand images

howto.what: 当对话中出现图片而 Claude 看不到内容时，它会调用 modlens 把图片转成结构化 JSON（文字转写、版面、语义、视觉线索），据此回答并如实说明不确定处。
howto.when: 当对话里出现图片文件路径/URL（.png、.jpg 等）或 [Image #1]、[Unsupported Image] 等占位符，且 Claude 看不到图片时触发；用户要求安装或配置 modlens 时也触发。

say.text: 读取图片 /tmp/a.png 里的文字
say.note: Claude 会运行 modlens 并转述识别出的文字。

say.text: 帮我配置 modlens 的 Gemini API key
say.note: 进入配置流程，设置密钥。

say.text: 这个 [Image #1] 图片里有什么内容？
say.note: 占位图片也会触发 modlens 读取。

howto.what_en: When an image appears in conversation and Claude cannot see it, it runs modlens to convert it into structured JSON (transcribed words, layout regions, semantics, visual clues) and answers from that evidence, noting any uncertainty instead of guessing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an image path/URL with image extensions (.png, .jpg, etc.) or a placeholder such as [Image #1] or [Unsupported Image] appears and Claude cannot see it; also when the user asks to install or configure modlens.

say_en.note: Claude runs modlens and reports the transcription.

say_en.text: Set up my Gemini API key for modlens
